title: The Fight Over the Next Pandemic

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七个十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢一锅端的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可享受特别优惠，网址为nytimes.com斜杠subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: At the height of the COVID pandemic, nearly 200 countries started negotiating a plan to ensure they did better when the next pandemic inevitably arrives.
sentences.zh: 在新冠疫情最严重的时候，近200个国家开始谈判一项计划，以确保在下一次疫情不可避免地到来时，他们能做得更好。

sentences.en: Their deadline for that plan was last week.
sentences.zh: 该计划的截止日期是上周。

sentences.en: My colleague, Apoorva Mondavili, explains why so far those negotiations have failed.
sentences.zh: 我的同事阿普尔娃·蒙达维利解释了为什么这些谈判至今未能成功。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, June 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月6日，星期四。

sentences.en: So, Apoorva, something that was supposed to happen, and happened right now, that I think most of us didn't even know was ever in the works, hasn't happened.
sentences.zh: 所以，阿普尔娃，有一件本该发生、且此刻正在发生的事——我认为我们大多数人甚至都不知道它正在酝酿中——却一直没有发生。

sentences.en: And that's a global plan for the next pandemic.
sentences.zh: 那就是针对下一次疫情的全球计划。

sentences.en: So, tell us this entire story.
sentences.zh: 那么，跟我们讲讲这个完整的故事吧。

sentences.en: Think back to 2021, the very worst days of COVID, when we had thousands of people dying in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 回想一下2021年，那是新冠疫情最糟糕的日子，当时我们在美国和其他国家有成千上万的人死亡。

sentences.en: and in the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 以及世界其他地方。

sentences.en: There was just so much confusion about whether to wear masks or not, whether to close schools.
sentences.zh: 当时有太多的混乱，关于是否该戴口罩，是否该关闭学校。

sentences.en: And it was very difficult to think what any country should do.
sentences.zh: 而且很难去思考任何国家究竟该怎么做。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so, in the middle of that chaos and confusion...
sentences.zh: 因此，在那片混乱与迷茫之中……

sentences.en: The eagle has landed.
sentences.zh: 鹰已着陆。

sentences.en: Carrying the hopes of a country, the first shipment of coronavirus vaccines reach Australian skies.
sentences.zh: 承载着一个国家的希望，第一批冠状病毒疫苗抵达了澳大利亚上空。

sentences.en: We did get the vaccines.
sentences.zh: 我们确实拿到了疫苗。

sentences.en: You're watching right now, history being made, one of the first people in the entire country right here to get dose number two of the Pfizer vaccine.
sentences.zh: 你现在正在观看历史的创造，全国最早接种辉瑞疫苗第二剂的人之一，就在这里。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, there was this hope.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，燃起了这种希望。

sentences.en: But the thing is that those vaccines were really mostly available in the richer countries.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，这些疫苗实际上主要只在较富裕的国家供应。

sentences.en: Parts of Asia and Latin America have recorded a spike in COVID fatalities amid medical supply and vaccine shortages.
sentences.zh: 在医疗物资和疫苗短缺的背景下，亚洲和拉丁美洲的部分地区记录到了新冠死亡病例的激增。

sentences.en: Few people in Africa have been vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 非洲几乎没有人接种过疫苗。

sentences.en: Some countries don't have any vaccines at all.
sentences.zh: 有些国家根本没有任何疫苗。

sentences.en: So, we in the United States and a lot of countries in the European Union and some of the other high- and middle-income countries had the vaccines.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们美国、欧盟的许多国家以及其他一些高收入和中等收入国家拥有疫苗。

sentences.en: Rich countries have enough doses to vaccinate everyone nearly three times over, whilst poor countries don't have enough to even reach health workers and people at risk.
sentences.zh: 富裕国家的疫苗剂量足够为每个人接种近三遍，而贫穷国家的疫苗甚至不够分给医务人员和高危人群。

sentences.en: But elsewhere in the world, there were no vaccines, really.
sentences.zh: 但在世界其他地方，实际上根本没有疫苗。

sentences.en: It became obvious to some low- and middle-income countries that they were not going to do very well in this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 一些低收入和中等收入国家显而易见地意识到，在这场大流行中他们不会过得很好。

sentences.en: There were all these advance purchase orders from the richer countries, and they were having some very tough negotiations with pharma companies
sentences.zh: 富裕国家有所有这些预购订单，而且他们正在与制药公司进行非常艰难的谈判

sentences.en: that were, you know, charging them more than they were charging the rich countries.
sentences.zh: 这些公司，你知道的，向他们收取的费用比向富裕国家收取的还要高。

sentences.en: And by the end of that horrible, horrible year,
sentences.zh: 到那个可怕透顶的年份结束时，

sentences.en: more than 90% of people in the richer countries had had two doses of vaccine.
sentences.zh: 富裕国家中超过90%的人已经接种了两剂疫苗。

sentences.en: But 2% of people in low-income countries had had any vaccines.
sentences.zh: 但低收入国家只有2%的人接种了任何疫苗。

sentences.en: So that really just striking inequity made people realize this was just a mess.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种极其鲜明的不平等让人们意识到，这简直是一团糟。

sentences.en: We did not know how to deal with the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我们根本不知道该如何应对这场大流行。

sentences.en: The time to act is now.
sentences.zh: 现在就是行动的时刻。

sentences.en: So in December 2021, by the end of this year of inequity, we must not allow the memories of this crisis to fade and go back to business as usual.
sentences.zh: 所以在2021年12月，在这个不平等之年的末尾，我们绝不能让这场危机的记忆淡去，也不能回到一切照旧的老路上去。

sentences.en: The World Health Organization brought together all the countries.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织将所有国家聚集在了一起。

sentences.en: The impacts on our societies, economies, and health, especially for the poor and the most vulnerable, are too significant.
sentences.zh: 它对我们社会、经济和健康的冲击，尤其是对穷人和最弱势群体的冲击，实在是太显著了。

sentences.en: And launched this process to come up with a playbook to really think about how all the countries of the world need to prevent and respond to the next pandemic
sentences.zh: 并启动了这一进程，旨在制定一本行动手册，真正思考世界上所有国家该如何预防和应对下一次大流行，

sentences.en: and do it in a way that would protect everybody, rich and poor, across the world.
sentences.zh: 并以一种能够保护世界上所有人——无论贫富——的方式去做到这一点。

sentences.en: And the WHO decided that this discussion could not be just an informal conversation between health ministers,
sentences.zh: 世卫组织决定，这场讨论不能仅仅是卫生部长之间非正式的交谈，

sentences.en: that this needed to be an international treaty, a legally binding treaty, so that every country has to take this very seriously and everybody agrees on how to do this next time.
sentences.zh: 这必须是一项国际条约，一项具有法律约束力的条约，以便每个国家都必须极其严肃地对待此事，并且大家就下一次该如何做达成一致。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So at the very height of COVID's awfulness, these countries in the WHO are saying, we know you all are very, very busy fighting this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 所以在新冠疫情最可怕的巅峰时期，世卫组织中的这些国家在说：我们知道你们大家都在非常非常忙碌地抗击这场疫情。

sentences.en: It is taking up all your time and energy, but we need you to now start to think about how badly this is going
sentences.zh: 它占用了你们所有的时间和精力，但我们需要你们现在开始思考这种情况有多糟糕，

sentences.en: and not just fight the current pandemic, but start planning on a better way to fight the next one.
sentences.zh: 不仅要抗击当前的大流行，还要开始规划更好地抗击下一次大流行的方法。

sentences.en: That's kind of a big ask.
sentences.zh: 这算是一个不小的要求。

sentences.en: It is a big ask, but what is the alternative that we come to the next pandemic and have a repeat of all of the chaos and confusion we saw during COVID?
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个不小的要求，但替代方案是什么呢？就是迎来下一次大流行，然后重复我们在新冠期间看到的所有混乱与迷茫吗？

sentences.en: So I think it was an acknowledgement that we needed it.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这是一种承认，承认我们需要它。

sentences.en: We needed to come up with a plan.
sentences.zh: 我们需要拿出一个计划。

sentences.en: And it became obvious that part of that plan needed to be a way to repair the mistrust that had formed between low-income countries and high-income countries,
sentences.zh: 而且显而易见的是，该计划的一部分必须是找到一种方法，来修复低收入国家与高收入国家之间已经产生的互不信任，

sentences.en: and that without repairing that, we just did not really stand a good chance of fighting the next pandemic.
sentences.zh: 如果不修复这种信任，我们在应对下一次大流行时就真的没有胜算。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And of course, the thing about a global pandemic is that any weak link, any country that's not doing its part or getting what it needs, becomes a problem for every other country.
sentences.zh: 当然，全球大流行的一个特点是，任何薄弱环节、任何没有尽到自己责任或没有获得所需物资的国家，都会成为其他所有国家的问题。

sentences.en: That's the nature of a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这就是大流行的本质。

sentences.en: We need, we talked about this with you, we talked about this with our colleagues throughout the pandemic,
sentences.zh: 我们需要——我们跟你谈过这个，我们在整场大流行期间也跟我们的同事们谈过这个——

sentences.en: a system where there's a strong program and plan in every country so that the virus can be stamped out.
sentences.zh: 一个在每个国家都有强大项目和计划的系统，以便能够彻底消灭病毒。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: I mean, in the United States, more people died because of variants than they did because of the original virus.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在美国，死于变异病毒的人比死于原始病毒的人还要多。

sentences.en: And a lot of those variants started in countries that did not have access to vaccines.
sentences.zh: 其中许多变异病毒始于那些无法获得疫苗的国家。

sentences.en: Okay, so what do these talks start to actually look like?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么这些谈判实际看起来是怎样的呢？

sentences.en: And just how many countries end up being involved in them?
sentences.zh: 最终到底有多少国家参与其中？

sentences.en: So all of the countries that are member states of the World Health Organization were involved in this.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织的所有成员国都参与了进来。

sentences.en: It's 194 countries.
sentences.zh: 总共有194个国家。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And they all sent delegates to meet, to draft something, and then to discuss every aspect of it and try to come to a consensus.
sentences.zh: 他们都派出了代表开会，起草某份文件，然后讨论其中的方方面面，并试图达成共识。

sentences.en: And the goal was to get that to a point where all the countries were ready to sign off on it by May 2024.
sentences.zh: 目标是将其推进到2024年5月之前所有国家都准备好签署的地步。

sentences.en: They had meetings over a period of two and a half years to talk through this.
sentences.zh: 他们在两年半的时间里举行了多次会议来讨论这件事。

sentences.en: Some sections, they all agreed on pretty easily.
sentences.zh: 有些部分，他们都相当容易地达成了一致。

sentences.en: You know, you can imagine like the general goals, like, yes, we should have a good plan to fight a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你可以想象比如那些总体目标，比方说，是的，我们应该有一个对抗大流行的好计划。

sentences.en: Or yes, we should have good research on vaccines and drugs.
sentences.zh: 或者说，是的，我们应该对疫苗和药物进行出色的研究。

sentences.en: Things like that.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: The general sort of philosophical goals, everybody agrees on.
sentences.zh: 那种普遍的哲学目标，所有人都是赞同的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Principles are always the easiest thing to negotiate.
sentences.zh: 原则总是最容易谈判的。

sentences.en: Easiest thing to negotiate.
sentences.zh: 最容易谈判的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But then you start getting into how this happens, right?
sentences.zh: 但接着你们就开始深入探讨这具体该如何实现，对吧？

sentences.en: And it's actually kind of interesting in the draft.
sentences.zh: 这在草案中其实挺有趣的。

sentences.en: If you look at the drafts, they have areas that are green, which means everybody sort of agreed.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看这些草案，它们有绿色区域，这意味着大家基本上都同意了。

sentences.en: And yellow, which means they're starting to come to an agreement.
sentences.zh: 还有黄色区域，意味着他们正开始达成一致。

sentences.en: There's sort of general consensus.
sentences.zh: 存在某种普遍共识。

sentences.en: And then white, which means it's like really no agreement.
sentences.zh: 然后是白色区域，这意味着真的没有任何共识。

sentences.en: They're just not even on the same page.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至根本不在同一个频道上。

sentences.en: And when you look at what's green across all of these drafts, the philosophical goals, green from the start.
sentences.zh: 当你看看所有这些草案中哪些是绿色时，那些哲学目标，从一开始就是绿色的。

sentences.en: No problem.
sentences.zh: 没有问题。

sentences.en: The yellow started to come slowly.
sentences.zh: 黄色区域慢慢开始出现。

sentences.en: These areas of consensus, things like, for example, safety measures in the labs that work with dangerous viruses.
sentences.zh: 这些达成共识的领域，比如处理危险病毒的实验室中的安全措施。

sentences.en: And that's not just because one of the theories about COVID is that the virus leaked from a lab.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是因为关于新冠的一个理论是病毒从实验室泄漏。

sentences.en: We know from long before COVID that lab safety is very important for making sure that those dangerous viruses don't get out into the world.
sentences.zh: 我们在新冠很久之前就知道，实验室安全对于确保那些危险病毒不会泄漏到世界上至关重要。

sentences.en: There's also agreement around how countries should do surveillance to see what outbreaks might be emerging.
sentences.zh: 对于国家应如何进行监测以发现可能出现的疫情，各方也存在共识。

sentences.en: And some of that stuff is tricky.
sentences.zh: 其中有些内容很棘手。

sentences.en: Why is it tricky?
sentences.zh: 为什么棘手？

sentences.en: I mean, isn't there a pretty standard playbook for trying to detect a virus and what to do once you detect it?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，难道没有一套相当标准的操作手册来检测病毒以及检测到后该怎么做吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然有。

sentences.en: But there are some things that are big sticking points like money.
sentences.zh: 但有些事情是重大的分歧点，比如资金。

sentences.en: Not all countries have the resources to do the kind of surveillance that they need to do.
sentences.zh: 并非所有国家都有资源来进行他们所需的那种监测。

sentences.en: And so who funds that?
sentences.zh: 那么这笔钱由谁来出？

sentences.en: And then, you know,
sentences.zh: 然后呢，你知道的，

sentences.en: some countries have vested interests like Argentina wouldn't want any rules that forbid sort of export of certain kinds of meat products because that's a big part of their economy.
sentences.zh: 有些国家有既得利益，比如阿根廷不希望有任何规则禁止某种肉类产品的出口，因为那是他们经济的很大一部分。

sentences.en: There are countries where live animal markets are a thing.
sentences.zh: 有些国家的活禽市场很普遍。

sentences.en: And not just in China, which we're all familiar with as another origin theory for COVID.
sentences.zh: 不仅在中国——我们都很熟悉中国是新冠的另一个起源理论。

sentences.en: Lots of other countries rely on these markets.
sentences.zh: 许多其他国家也依赖这些市场。

sentences.en: And they don't want to have very strict rules about which animals can be held together and how densely packed they can or can't be.
sentences.zh: 他们不想制定非常严格的规则来规定哪些动物可以关在一起、它们的密集程度能或不能达到多少。

sentences.en: So when you start to get into the details, it is actually difficult to reach consensus on some of these things.
sentences.zh: 所以当你开始深入细节时，要在其中一些事情上达成共识其实是很困难的。

sentences.en: But they have made a lot of progress and they have come to yellow and green on some important things like that every country should have, you know,
sentences.zh: 但他们已经取得了很大进展，并且在一些重要事情上达成了黄色和绿色共识，例如每个国家都应该拥有一支，你知道的，

sentences.en: a health care workforce trained to respond to a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 经过培训能够应对大流行的医疗卫生劳动力。

sentences.en: That they should make best efforts to have local production of things like vaccines and drugs and that they should provide all of these resources to their own citizens.
sentences.zh: 他们应尽最大努力在本地生产疫苗和药物之类的事物，并且应该向自己的公民提供所有这些资源。

sentences.en: Things like that.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: Those are all, you know, under agreement.
sentences.zh: 这些全都在，你知道的，达成协议的范围内。

sentences.en: They're all green now.
sentences.zh: 它们现在全都是绿色的。

sentences.en: So what exactly is holding these negotiations back?
sentences.zh: 那么到底是什么在阻碍这些谈判？

sentences.en: What ends up being the biggest remaining conflict?
sentences.zh: 最终剩下的最大冲突是什么？

sentences.en: It won't surprise you to hear, Michael, that the biggest conflict is exactly what all of this began with,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，听到这个你不会感到惊讶，最大的冲突正是这一切最初的起因，

sentences.en: which is the lack of access that low-income countries have to things like vaccines.
sentences.zh: 也就是低收入国家缺乏获取疫苗等物资的渠道。

sentences.en: There have been interesting proposals in the drafts, and one in particular, that would solve at least some of this issue.
sentences.zh: 草案中出现了一些有趣的提议，其中特别有一项，能够解决至少一部分这个问题。

sentences.en: But it's been very difficult to convince rich countries, middle-income countries, and low-income countries that that proposal would be of great benefit to everybody involved.
sentences.zh: 但要说服富裕国家、中等收入国家和低收入国家相信该提议对所有相关方都有巨大好处，是非常困难的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是威娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了游戏《Connections》（中文名通常为“连连看”或同义词），这是《纽约时报》游戏中的一个益智游戏。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天都创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色幻觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时会看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com斜杠games，今天就开始游玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Apoorva, tell us about this particular proposal that could do a lot of work to solve the inequities at the center of these negotiations,
sentences.zh: 那么，阿普尔娃，请跟我们讲讲这个特殊的提议，它本可以在解决这些谈判核心的不平等问题上发挥很大作用，

sentences.en: and why that proposal has created so much conflict.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么这个提议会引发如此多的冲突。

sentences.en: The heart of the section that has really created the most conflict is whether low-income countries get access to vaccines in a timely manner and at a cost that is affordable to them.
sentences.zh: 真正引发最多冲突的那一部分的核心在于，低收入国家是否能以及时的方式、以它们负担得起的成本获取疫苗。

sentences.en: And all the low-income countries, you know, recognize that they don't have a lot of bargaining power.
sentences.zh: 所有的低收入国家，你知道的，都承认他们没有太多的谈判筹码。

sentences.en: They were treated pretty poorly by pharma companies during this past pandemic.
sentences.zh: 在过去这场大流行期间，他们受到了制药公司相当糟糕的对待。

sentences.en: And so they've been thinking about setting things up so that that does not happen again, that the next time around, they are not left behind.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一直在考虑建立某种机制，以确保这种情况不会再次发生，确保下一次他们不会被抛在后面。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But like you said, they don't have a lot of power to bargain.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，他们在谈判中并没有太多的筹码。

sentences.en: They don't.
sentences.zh: 确实没有。

sentences.en: But, you know, there have been times when poor countries have come up with a way to make everybody else realize that they're essential to this whole process.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，有时贫穷国家会想出一些办法，让其他人意识到他们在整个过程中是不可或缺的。

sentences.en: So let me give you an example of this that really, I think, illustrates how much everybody else needs the low-income nations during an outbreak.
sentences.zh: 所以我来举个例子，我认为这真的说明了在疫情期间，其他所有人都多么需要低收入国家。

sentences.en: So in 2006, Indonesia was battling a bird flu outbreak.
sentences.zh: 所以在2006年，印度尼西亚正在抗击禽流感疫情。

sentences.en: And they had been very dutifully sending samples of the virus that they had in their country to the World Health Organization labs to analyze.
sentences.zh: 他们一直非常尽责地将国内获取的病毒样本发送到世界卫生组织实验室进行分析。

sentences.en: And, you know, that information helps pharma companies develop things like vaccines.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道，这些信息有助于制药公司开发疫苗之类东西。

sentences.en: Or tests, right.
sentences.zh: 或者是检测，对吧。

sentences.en: Or tests.
sentences.zh: 或者是检测。

sentences.en: And in this particular case, the Indonesian Health Ministry approached the World Health Organization to say, look, we've given you these samples.
sentences.zh: 而在这次特定事件中，印尼卫生部接洽世卫组织表示，听着，我们把这些样本交给了你们。

sentences.en: We have people dying in our country.
sentences.zh: 我们国内有人在死去。

sentences.en: And we need access to vaccines and drugs.
sentences.zh: 我们需要获得疫苗和药物。

sentences.en: And the WHO told them, sorry, we don't directly distribute any of that.
sentences.zh: 而世卫组织告诉他们，抱歉，我们不直接分发这些东西。

sentences.en: You have to talk to the manufacturers.
sentences.zh: 你们必须去跟制造商谈。

sentences.en: And this is where that leverage becomes really important, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是筹码变得非常重要的地方，对吗？

sentences.en: Because Indonesia did not actually have leverage with these pharma companies.
sentences.zh: 因为印尼实际上并没有对这些制药公司的筹码。

sentences.en: And so the vaccine manufacturer told them that they would sell them vaccines, but at commercial prices that that country cannot afford.
sentences.zh: 所以疫苗制造商告诉他们，他们会向他们出售疫苗，但却是该国承担不起的商业价格。

sentences.en: And then a drug manufacturer told them that they did not have enough drugs to give Indonesia because richer countries had placed enough purchase orders that there was a delay of two years.
sentences.zh: 然后一家药物制造商告诉他们，他们没有足够的药物提供给印尼，因为较富裕的国家已经下了足够的采购订单，导致有两年的延误。

sentences.en: So Indonesia was so angry about all of this that they declined to share any more samples with the WHO.
sentences.zh: 因此印尼对此感到非常愤怒，以至于他们拒绝再与世卫组织分享任何样本。

sentences.en: So Indonesia basically says we will never again make the mistake of promptly sharing information about a potentially deadly pathogen because we learned that we get nothing in return.
sentences.zh: 所以印尼基本上是说，我们再也不会犯迅速分享潜在致命病原体信息的错误了，因为我们了解到我们什么也换不回来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And that understanding, that realization also has driven a lot of the conversation in the drafting of this treaty where low-income countries have essentially said,
sentences.zh: 这种理解和认识也推动了起草这项条约时的许多对话，低收入国家基本上表示，

sentences.en: we recognize that you need us to share these samples,
sentences.zh: 我们承认你们需要我们分享这些样本，

sentences.en: but we are not going to do that unless you can promise to us that we will get some access to vaccines and drugs that you make based on the samples we give you.
sentences.zh: 但除非你们能向我们承诺，我们能够获得你们根据我们提供的样本所制造的疫苗和药物，否则我们不会这样做。

sentences.en: So we want something in return for the information we provide to you.
sentences.zh: 所以我们希望为提供给你们的信息得到一些回报。

sentences.en: What is the specific proposal that comes from this realization?
sentences.zh: 这种认识带来了什么具体提案？

sentences.en: Yeah, this proposal has created a lot of controversy, so there are versions of it.
sentences.zh: 是的，这个提案引发了很大的争议，所以它有不同的版本。

sentences.en: But the most recent one says essentially that if the low-income countries share their samples with the WHO,
sentences.zh: 但最新版本基本上规定，如果低收入国家与世卫组织分享他们的样本，

sentences.en: that pharma companies have to give the WHO 10% of the vaccines they make as a donation, and then 10% either at a non-profit cost or just a deeply discounted rate also to the WHO,
sentences.zh: 制药公司必须将他们生产的疫苗的10%作为捐赠给世卫组织，然后另外10%以非营利成本或大幅折扣价提供给世卫组织，

sentences.en: and then the WHO would distribute that 20% of vaccines that they get from the pharma companies to the countries that are in most need.
sentences.zh: 接着世卫组织会将从制药公司获得的这20%的疫苗分发给最需要的国家。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So this proposal, which feels very innovative, is the ultimate manifestation of poor countries' power in this dynamic.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个感觉非常具有创新性的提案，是贫穷国家在这种动态中权力的终极体现。

sentences.en: If they don't get vaccines, then the big countries will never get the information about a virus that's necessary for there to have ever been a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 如果他们拿不到疫苗，那么大国就永远无法获得制造疫苗所必需的病毒信息。

sentences.en: It's really interesting.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: It isn't, and this is the biggest chip that low-income countries have, so they are not willing to budge on this.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，这是低收入国家拥有的最大筹码，所以他们在这点上绝不妥协。

sentences.en: But guess who doesn't like this?
sentences.zh: 但你猜谁不喜欢这个？

sentences.en: Pharmaceutical companies.
sentences.zh: 制药公司。

sentences.en: And the countries that really support the interests of the pharmaceutical companies, and that includes the United States, Germany, Switzerland, some of the big players.
sentences.zh: 以及那些真正支持制药公司利益的国家，其中包括美国、德国、瑞士等一些主要大国。

sentences.en: Places where these companies are a big presence and a very powerful lobby.
sentences.zh: 这些公司在这些地方有着巨大的存在感和非常强大的游说力量。

sentences.en: What specifically have these pharmaceutical companies and the countries like the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些制药公司以及像美国这样拥有众多此类公司的国家，

sentences.en: that have so many of them said about this proposal?
sentences.zh: 对这个提案究竟说了什么？

sentences.en: So the countries, they are willing to give in principle and say that the pharmaceutical companies will voluntarily give some of the vaccines to the WHO,
sentences.zh: 所以这些国家愿意在原则上做出让步，表示制药公司会自愿向世卫组织提供部分疫苗，

sentences.en: but they don't want it mandated, whereas the low-income countries, they want it to be really codified so that there is no loophole.
sentences.zh: 但他们不希望这是强制性的，而低收入国家则希望将其真正写入法条，这样就不会有漏洞。

sentences.en: And the conversations have gone round and round on that one word, voluntary.
sentences.zh: 双方的对话一直在“自愿”这个词上绕来绕去。

sentences.en: Apoorva, is it safe to assume that a country like the U.S., which of course has a booming and very profitable pharmaceutical industry,
sentences.zh: 阿浦尔娃，是否可以认为，像美国这样一个拥有蓬勃发展且利润丰厚的制药行业的国家，

sentences.en: won't sign on to these proposals unless that word voluntary is in the deal, that they cannot abide by one where it's mandatory,
sentences.zh: 除非协议中包含“自愿”这个词，否则是不会签署这些提案的，他们无法接受强制性的条款，

sentences.en: that these big pharmaceutical companies have to give up so much of their vaccine to poorer countries?
sentences.zh: 即这些大型制药公司必须向较穷国家让出这么大份额的疫苗？

sentences.en: They are not going to say that in so many words, but yes.
sentences.zh: 他们不会把话说得这么绝对，但确实如此。

sentences.en: And the United States actually has come up with some very nice plans to help some of these low-income countries set up infrastructure and be prepared for pandemics.
sentences.zh: 而且美国实际上已经提出了一些非常不错的计划，来帮助其中一些低收入国家建立基础设施并为大流行做好准备。

sentences.en: But I think crossing pharmaceutical companies is not a place they will go.
sentences.zh: 但我想惹恼制药公司是他们不会涉足的领域。

sentences.en: So is that really the only big obstacle left in these negotiations, or is there anything else?
sentences.zh: 那么这真的是这些谈判中剩下的唯一大障碍，还是有其他问题？

sentences.en: Oh, there's lots more.
sentences.zh: 哦，还有很多呢。

sentences.en: There has been so much misinformation and disinformation around this whole issue, just like there has been about every aspect of COVID.
sentences.zh: 围绕这个整个议题，有着太多的虚假信息和错误信息，就像关于新冠的每一个方面一样。

sentences.en: And a lot of it centers around the hesitation and the opposition that many populist leaders have expressed.
sentences.zh: 其中很大一部分集中在许多民粹主义领导人所表达的犹豫和反对上。

sentences.en: In the U.S., for example, there are Republican senators and governors who have come out against the treaty,
sentences.zh: 例如在美国，有些共和党参议员和州长站出来反对该条约，

sentences.en: and they say that this is a power grab by the WHO, that it is going to allow the director general of the WHO to tell the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们说这是世卫组织在争夺权力，这将允许世卫组织总干事对美国指手画脚，

sentences.en: what to do, whether to have mask mandates, whether to have vaccine mandates, none of which is true, by the way.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们该做什么，是否实施口罩令，是否实施疫苗令，顺便说一句，这些全都是假的。

sentences.en: And in a bid to counter some of that misinformation, there is actually an explicit line in the treaty saying that the treaty respects the sovereignty of all the individual nations.
sentences.zh: 为了反击其中一些虚假信息，条约中实际上有一行明确的条款，声明该条约尊重所有主权国家的独立性。

sentences.en: They've tried to address that head on, but it hasn't really made all of that chatter go away.
sentences.zh: 他们试图正面解决这个问题，但这并没有真正让所有这些杂音消失。

sentences.en: How much does this practically matter, the fact that a handful or perhaps more than a handful of Republicans in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这在多大程度上具有实际意义：美国的一小撮或者说不止一小撮共和党人

sentences.en: are skeptical of this and think, ideologically speaking, that it oversteps the bounds of what a treaty should do?
sentences.zh: 对此持怀疑态度，并且从意识形态上认为这超越了一个条约应有的界限？

sentences.en: I mean, ultimately, do they have any power over whether the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，归根结底，他们对美国是否

sentences.en: signs this treaty?
sentences.zh: 签署这项条约有任何权力吗？

sentences.en: They do, because delegates can agree to this treaty at the WHO, but everybody has to bring it back to their home countries.
sentences.zh: 他们有，因为代表们可以在世卫组织同意这项条约，但每个人都必须将它带回各自的国家。

sentences.en: And in the U.S., the treaty then has to be approved for ratification by the Senate.
sentences.zh: 在美国，然后必须由参议院批准该条约的批准手续。

sentences.en: You have to have a two-thirds majority in the Senate saying, yes, we agree to this treaty.
sentences.zh: 参议院必须有三分之二的多数票通过，说，是的，我们同意这项条约。

sentences.en: So if you have a number of Republican senators who are absolutely opposed to it, it may not pass.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有一定数量的共和党参议员绝对反对它，它可能就无法通过。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So it very much feels like so many of the issues that made everyone think this treaty was necessary,
sentences.zh: 所以这很像许多让每个人都认为该条约是必不可少的问题，

sentences.en: inequities between rich countries and poor countries, and misinformation and ideological skepticism of how to handle a pandemic to begin with,
sentences.zh: 富国与穷国之间的不平等，以及关于如何从一开始应对大流行的错误信息和意识形态怀疑，

sentences.en: that really defined COVID for us, that those forces are now making it very hard for this treaty to actually be reached.
sentences.zh: 那些曾为我们定义了新冠疫情的力量，现在正使这项条约极难真正达成。

sentences.en: They never really went away.
sentences.zh: 它们从未真正消失。

sentences.en: They never went away.
sentences.zh: 它们从未消失。

sentences.en: It felt like there was about five seconds when everyone was united in thinking that we needed something different, and there was a lot of goodwill.
sentences.zh: 感觉好像有那么大约五秒钟，大家团结一致，认为我们需要一些不同的东西，并且充满了善意。

sentences.en: But a lot of that has evaporated, and we're getting very quickly to a point where people have forgotten what COVID looked like
sentences.zh: 但其中很大一部分已经消散，我们非常快地回到了这样一个地步：人们已经忘记了新冠疫情看起来是什么样的，

sentences.en: and felt like and what the devastation was like, and have gone back to old positions on, you know,
sentences.zh: 感觉是什么样的，毁灭性是怎样的，并回到了老旧的立场上，你知道的，

sentences.en: we don't want to share, we don't want to give anything away, everything for us first, all of the thinking that led to the problems during COVID.
sentences.zh: 我们不想分享，我们不想放弃任何东西，一切以我们自己为先，所有这些导致了新冠期间种种问题的思维方式。

sentences.en: So what realistically happens now?
sentences.zh: 那么现实中接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: And do you, based on your reporting, think that this treaty has any real chance of being completed and passed by the 194 countries involved in it?
sentences.zh: 根据你的报道，你认为这项条约有任何真正的机会在参与其中的194个国家中最终敲定并通过吗？

sentences.en: Well, the draft was supposed to be finalized at the meeting last week of the World Health Assembly, and that didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 嗯，原本计划在上周的世界卫生大会会议上最终确定草案，但这并没有发生。

sentences.en: But they did set a deadline to say that the negotiations will continue, and then they'll hope to have something done by next year's meeting.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实设定了一个最后期限，表示谈判将继续进行，然后希望在明年的会议上完成一些工作。

sentences.en: But there's just so much in flux right now.
sentences.zh: 但现在有太多事情处于变动之中。

sentences.en: You know, there are elections all over the world.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，世界各地都在举行选举。

sentences.en: Who knows what Donald Trump will do if he gets elected.
sentences.zh: 谁知道唐纳德·特朗普如果当选会做些什么。

sentences.en: We know that he withdrew from the WHO the last time around.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他上次退出了世卫组织。

sentences.en: And he has even said that he may shut down the pandemic preparedness office in the White House.
sentences.zh: 他甚至说过，他可能会关闭白宫的大流行防范办公室。

sentences.en: So he's not particularly invested in this whole topic, this whole issue.
sentences.zh: 所以他对这个整题、这个议题并不是特别投入。

sentences.en: And in the meantime, we already have so many threats that are really picking up, you know, for global health experts and for reporters like myself who watch all this stuff.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，对于全球卫生专家和像我这样关注所有这些事情的记者来说，我们已经面临着如此多正在加剧的威胁。

sentences.en: It's a bit alarming that we now have bird flu right here in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我们在美国本土就出现了禽流感，这有点令人担忧。

sentences.en: And the next pandemic, pretty much every expert I talk to agrees, it's not a question of if, but when.
sentences.zh: 而下一次大流行，我交谈过的几乎每位专家都认为，这不是会不会发生的问题，而是何时发生的问题。

sentences.en: And if we had had this treaty ready, if we can ever have this treaty ready, we would be so much better prepared for something like that to happen.
sentences.zh: 如果我们当时准备好了这份条约，如果我们能让这份条约准备就绪，我们就能为发生这样的事情做好更充分的准备。

sentences.en: But it just doesn't seem all that likely right now.
sentences.zh: 但目前看来似乎并不太可能。

sentences.en: Well, Aporva, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，阿浦尔娃，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: In a last-minute about-face, New York Governor Kathy Hogel said she would block a long-awaited tolling plan, known as congestion pricing,
sentences.zh: 在最后一刻的大转弯中，纽约州长凯西·霍楚尔表示她将阻止一项备受期待的收费计划，即所谓的拥堵定价，

sentences.en: that was set to begin at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 该计划原定于月底开始实施。

sentences.en: The program, the first of its kind in the U.S., would have charged as much as $15 for cars entering the busiest parts of Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 该计划是美国首个此类计划，将对进入曼哈顿最繁忙地区的汽车收取高达15美元的费用。

sentences.en: The goal was to alleviate traffic, reduce pollution, and raise money for the city's aging subway system.
sentences.zh: 其目标是缓解交通、减少污染，并为该市老化的地铁系统筹集资金。

sentences.en: But, Hogel argued that the tolls threatened the city's fragile economic recovery after the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 但霍楚尔认为，收费威胁到该市在疫情后脆弱的经济复苏。

sentences.en: And, on Thursday, former romantic partners of Hunter Biden, the president's son,
sentences.zh: 此外，在周四，总统之子亨特·拜登的前女友们

sentences.en: testified in a Delaware courtroom about the depths of his drug addiction and the toll that it took on them.
sentences.zh: 在特拉华州法庭上作证，讲述了他毒瘾的深重以及这对她们造成的伤害。

sentences.en: The testimony, including how much Hunter Biden spent on drugs and the type of drugs he used,
sentences.zh: 这些证词，包括亨特·拜登花在毒品上的金额以及他使用的毒品类型，

sentences.en: was designed to establish that he was a chronic drug abuser who lied when he claimed to be sober on an application for a handgun in 2018.
sentences.zh: 旨在证明他是一个长期吸毒者，他在2018年申请购买手枪时谎称自己已经戒毒。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Alex Stern, Carlos Prieto, and Stella Tan, with help from Will Reed and Ricky Nevetsky.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由亚历克斯·斯特恩、卡洛斯·普里耶托和斯特拉·谭制作，威尔·里德和里基·内韦茨基提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lexi Diao and Devin Taylor, contains original music by Marian Lozano, Pat McCusker, and Diane Wong, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 节目由莱克西·刁和德文·泰勒剪辑，包含玛丽安·洛扎诺、帕特·麦卡斯克和黛安·王的原创作曲，并由克里斯·伍德担任音频工程。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lanthford of Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由仙境乐队的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰特福德创作。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时又惊心动魄的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格一起，讲述人们试图维持其影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
